title: It’s amazing!!
body: I did download it immediately last year when it started. Yes, most things are behind a paywall but I think it’s affordable for most people. Due to my undiagnosed ADHD I experience depression phases from time to time and I’m not able to join the app. But when I try it again, it’s fun every time. Especially the live sessions. Nicki is my favorite host and she always manages to make me feel good, no matter how low my energy is or how much I get done. I wish I could find the energy to join the sessions in my depression phases.
author: Kleine Rebellin

title: 🩷 This app is made of love
body: Made by someone i really trust that can bring good and creative insoghts and Eureka moments for whom need it.
author: Shadowsofself

title: Helps me so much to change the way I clean
body: I downloaded dubbii in late 2024 and oh my- has it changed my life. I struggled so much to find the motivation to start tasks or to keep doing things I didn’t like (no dopamine in it). Every video is split into easy steps- one thing at a time without “side quests”- a “mega task” is now manageable because of all the little steps and encouragements along the way through Rox or Rich. I just “found” the live sessions for me in my christmas break- I was ill at home and kinda stuck- all the other dubbers kept me company as I tackled all my daily chores. That was a really pleasant experience. Every live sessions host is an expert in motivating everyone in doing the things they need/want to do or get things done. Also the nudges for chores and tasks are so helpful. Thank you for creating and developing this  app. It’s brilliant.
author: Lilly Ann Tuesday

title: Love it!
body: Finally managed to declutter & not get distracted in the middle ❤️ thanks Rox!
author: Yourfavouritestereotype

title: Super!
body: Einfach zu bedienen und hilft total beim Routine aufbauen und einhalten :-)
author: camblin97

title: Pay wall on every front
body: Honestly, I was looking forward to this app and I especially wanted to because I like the creators however I’m a little bit frustrated because everything is sitting behind a pay wall I understand that maybe they could not make all the videos accessible or even all the life sessions but I think that maybe five live sessions per day could be for free users as well.
author: Lexx19976

title: Einfach Klasse!
body: Diese App habe ich gebraucht! Endlich schaffe ich es, Sachen zu erledigen und ich merke, dass ich nicht alleine bin! Für mich hat die App fast einen „Placebo- Effekt“: sogar wenn ich nur an sie denke, erledige ich viel mehr als früher. Vorschläge die gemacht werden, werden oft auch aufgenommen, die App ist toll gestaltet und läuft sehr sehr stabil. Ich empfehle sie zu 100%!
author: Claudia Krol

title: A lovely and helpful Duo
body: You guys are helping me loads with your body doubling videos. I can t believe how much it helps. Love you guys, thank you thank you thank you 💕
author: CristinaTor

title: Made with love
body:
This app is absolutely made with love. Feels like Rox and Rich are with me in my apartment to help me lol 
Thank you so much for making this app! I’m excited for the next tasks
author: Treesandfreeways

title: Thank you!
body: This is perfect. I struggle a lot with procrastination and with starting on the tasks around the house. I get overwhelmed so easily and this just helps me focus on the tasks ♥️

title: Very useful app both for the ADHD and the non ADHD partner
body:
Hey I really love your app it helps my wife and I a lot with structuring our day to day lives especially when we feel overwhelmed. 
Can I ask whether it is possible to obtain family sharing for the app in any way so we can use the app together?
author: misssunangel

title: Funny and productive App
body:
I really enjoyed my first Video for free (which I found funny what you say at the beginning to first try it before impulsive buying it… almost done that ;) )
I successfully and without shame followed Rox to make my bed ( to suffer together felt half as bad, thank you).
 Much Love, I hope you continue with what you do, your content has changed so much in my life and for myself and I look forward to further explore this App!
author: kathi94123

title: Interesting but...
body:
... I downloaded it yesterday and I love the concept. I do not know if it is sustainable, but it helped.

The biggest problem I have currently that would decide if I wanted to subscribe. What are the other tasks. I get that you have a free course and this is ok, but I would love to see the other tasks just to see if there is something for the task I have the most troubles with.

A list of available tasks in the app description would be enough for now, but ideally you would show them in the app (disabled).

The other thing is Laundry is split into multiple steps and this is good, but the description could be a bit better. Something like prepare laundry or so for the first.

Maybe with a thumbnail just to make it visually easier to distinguish.
author: Beardeddragon5
